prompt: Edit the attached exact LPC pixel sprite strip without redesigning the character. Keep THREE equal square cells in one horizontal row at identical positions and directions: down/front, right profile, back. Same pale male NPC with short black hair partly across forehead, dark navy tied headband with narrow tails in back view, dark navy crossover robe, navy waist sash, charcoal trousers and brown slippers with white trim. Draw only a tiny courteous chin-down acknowledgment nod: move head, hair and headband/tails as one continuous shape about ONE logical pixel lower. Preserve original head size, face, silhouette, body proportions, simple chunky LPC source palette and hard enlarged pixel grid. All robe, sleeves, hands, waist, legs and feet below collar stay stationary and faithful. Transparent background with original generous margins, same 3:1 proportions as 768x256 reference. No added insignia, ornaments, weapons, tools, text, labels, magic, shadows, floor or base. Minor dialogue animation pose edit, no attack or spell.
